description:
Ask the worker to fix and resend their work. No money moves. At most 3 times per hire.
Use for: submitted work that waits for your review and can be fixed. The worker hands the fixed work in under the same submission id, so check `submission.status` with get_hire before you decide again.
Not for: accepting the work (pay_hire); refusing the work for good (reject_submission).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: request_redo({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","submissionId":"s_7Hd2kQ","message":"Shop 3 is out of focus. Please retake it.","redoDueAt":"2026-11-22T15:00:00.000Z"})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: no_submission, not_reviewable, hire_kind_not_supported, redo_limit_reached; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

message.description: What you tell the worker, 1 to 1000 characters.

redoDueAt.description: When the fixed work is due: 15 minutes to 7 days from now. With no deadline, reject_submission waits for the next hand-in.

submissionId.description: The submission you decide on: `submission.id` of the hire, from get_hire. When sent, the call is refused if the hire now shows another submission. Default: the submission the hire shows now.

name: request_redo

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks. Left out when there are none, and when status is left out: then read the hire with get_hire.

payStatus.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

status.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

submission.description: The submission of the hire as it stands after this call; get_hire shows all of it. Left out when no submission could be shown: the hire could not be read (status is left out too), or it now shows none you can see.

max.description: The most redos you may ask.

id.description: The submission id, also shown as submission.id by get_hire.

redoDueAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

title: Request a redo
